OCCUPATIONAL ENGLISH TEST
WRITING SUB-TEST              MEDICINE
TIME :                        READING: 5 MINUTES
                              WRITING : 40 MINUTES


Read the case notes below and complete the writing task which follows.
Notes:
You are a physician at the Emergency Department.
Patient name: Mr Peter Sullivne
DOB: 15/08/1963
Age : 56
Social History: single – no children
lives with elderly parent
Mother and father main carer
Livestock farmer , works long hours in the sun
Past medical history: 2006- excision malignant melanoma
2011- excision compound naevus- confirm by histology examination - no
action taken
2015- two ribs fracture
2016- forearm fracture
Medications: nil
Family history : moderate dementia – mother
 
07/07/2019
Presenting complaint:
He came to emergency department - severe right arm pain - by kick from
horse in farm
Subjective : bruise , swelling
Ulnar fracture confirmed by x-ray
Medications : Paracetamol
Arm sling - splint
Objective: large mole on his right shoulder - 6mm x 7mm - irregular edges -
variable colours - light brown to dark. Some irritation
Other Large raised mole on his neck - 5mm x 7mm - dark red - no oozing or
bleeding.
Plan : urgent referral to a dermatologist – biopsy.
Review after 2 weeks for his ulnar fracture
Writing Task
Using the information in the case notes , write a letter of a referral to Dr
Patrick Silvester . Address the letter to Dr Patrick Silvester , Consultant
Dermatologist ,Newtown Hospital , 81 Canyon Road , Newtown.
In your answer:
   Expand the relevant notes into complete sentences.
   Do not use note form.
   Use the letter form.
The body of the letter should be approximately 180 – 200 words.
